title: Customer-contextual regression ops and local eval hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a lightweight, customer-scoped evaluation and regression ops layer that binds model/config changes to localized eval hooks and gated rollouts for Dedicated and Private customers. The feature will let platform operators and customer SREs define per-customer eval sets, run local-only probes (no telemetry offload), and require passing health checks before model/config promotions.
goals: Enable engineering and customers to attach a small set of customer-specific evals to any model/config change
Provide a privacy-first execution mode where evals run inside customer VPC or on-prem (no telemetry leaves the boundary)
Surface deterministic pass/fail signals to the Redwood rollout engine to gate canary and full rollouts
Store minimal, privacy-preserving artifacts (hashes/metrics) to support audits without retaining raw prompts/outputs
non_goals: Replacing full-scale per-customer eval pipelines (this is for lightweight gating, not exhaustive benchmarking)
Sending raw customer prompts or outputs to Redwood-hosted analytics when privacy_mode is enabled
Building a new UI for authoring evals in this cycle (we will reuse existing console primitives)
success_metrics: >80% of Dedicated onboarding customers configure at least one localized eval within 30 days
Reduction in customer-facing regressions caused by model/config changes by >= 45% on customers using local eval hooks
Zero incidents of raw prompt leakage in privacy_mode during internal review period
Gated rollouts decrease rollback rate for promoted changes by >= 30% on enrolled tenants
scope: API surface: allow bindable 'local_eval_suite_id' on deployment and rollout configs
Execution: a lightweight runner container that executes evals inside customer VPC or Dedicated nodepool
Rollout integration: boolean pass/fail signal and aggregated metrics to control canary, A/B, and auto-fallback policies
Telemetry: only store cryptographic hashes and aggregated metrics when privacy_mode == true
Docs: quickstart for partner SREs and template evals for NLU/generation regressions
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): build runner + integration tests; run on 2 internal staging tenants — 2026-03-24 to 2026-04-07
Phase 1 (pilot): invite 3 existing Dedicated customers to opt in; validate privacy_mode and gating behavior — 2026-04-08 to 2026-05-05
Phase 2 (beta): enable opt-in via Console for more customers, add template eval library — 2026-05-06 to 2026-06-02
Phase 3 (general availability): enable default for new Dedicated customers, API docs and support playbook — target 2026-06-15
dependencies: ENG-43210 (runner containerization and VPC egress controls)
SEC-2101 (privacy review for hash-only telemetry storage)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: we prioritized minimal on-customer compute (short-run containers) over supporting arbitrary large eval corpora to limit scope and risk.
Hashing approach: SHA-256 of (prompt_id + normalized_output) agreed with SEC; goal is auditability without reconstructing user data.
Fallback semantics: if local eval runner is unreachable during canary, the rollout will pause and alert; automatic fallback will only proceed after manual approval for pilot customers.
Performance vs privacy: KV cache warming is disabled for local eval runs to avoid cross-tenant cache leakage; may re-evaluate if latency becomes a problem.
